trendAnalysis.outlook: The kwacha firmed again, with the USD/ZMW market mid easing ~1.20% to ~K19.49/USD (open.er-api.com, 24 Sep) from ~K19.72 the prior session, while the BoZ official mid sat at ~K19.51 (23 Sep, allratestoday). The pair sits near the lower end of its broad 18.40–19.80 consolidation band, and the move was broad-based across GBP (25.89), EUR (22.25), ZAR (1.194) and BWP (1.391), with CNY (2.914) likewise lower — i.e. a uniform kwacha firming, not a single-pair move. The official/parallel premium remains narrow, signalling no acute FX scarcity. With re-election formalised at the 1 Sep ceremony and the MPC held at 13.25% on 26 August, focus shifts to the 30 Sep MPC — the same day a 10% copper-concentrate export duty takes effect — plus the 2027 budget and the make-up of the new economic team.
trendAnalysis.projection3m: USD/ZMW 18.50–19.80 range. Post-election policy continuity supportive; import demand and copper-price swings the main risks.
trendAnalysis.projection6m: USD/ZMW 18.00–20.00 range. Direction hinges on fiscal continuity and copper earnings.
